notApplicable.rationale: Summa has no Limen engine or WASM code. Its only browser code is the local administration clients web/app.ts and web-hub/app.ts, which render data from the ROS hub server (tools/ros_hub_server.mjs) and own no application rules. Revisit when the proposed invoice requirements (INV-ARCH-006) introduce an engine behind Limen.
